shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin rebounded above $63K, driven by renewed ETF inflows ending a 10-day outflow streak.
Vitalik Buterin unveiled the "Lean Ethereum" roadmap, detailing future network upgrades.
Softer-than-expected US employment data and easing inflation concerns have improved overall market sentiment.
Geopolitical tensions remain elevated with recent events in Ukraine and China, though crypto's market reaction is neutral.
Despite recent price rallies, the Crypto Fear & Greed Index still indicates "Extreme Fear" among investors.
